sources.snippet: Fizgig v6.5.0, released on September 27, makes Qwen Image 2.1 a trainable base model inside the studio (GitHub | release notes | Qwen Image 2.1 guide). Fizgig already trains LoRAs, LoKRs and full fine-tunes for Flux 2 Klein, Krea 2 and MiniMax H3. This release brings the same toolset to Qwen's image model, and Qwen Image 2.1 is the first model added through the studio's new driver system ...
